description: Fetch a public image or video URL (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, MP4, MOV; max 15 MB) and report its hidden metadata: GPS coordinates, camera and lens, timestamps, software, C2PA/Content Credentials, AI-generator signals (Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, etc.), and how many bytes are metadata. Does not modify or store the file.
name: inspect_metadata
title: Inspect image or video metadata
